confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Spanish pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, since July rates in Córdoba vary with heat-season demand and event dates. Estimates assume roughly EUR/USD 1.16. The FX observation comes from search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct read of the F11.1 table, and 16 October may be provisional because RBA rates are published after 4 pm AEDT.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Spanish mid-sized Andalusian heritage cities such as Granada and Jaén, priced slightly below Seville and Málaga. Restaurant and hotel levels are benchmarked to typical Spanish tourist-city pricing. Cocktail and wine were set using the usual Spanish price relationship to draft beer (cocktail roughly 3.5x beer, wine glass roughly 1.25x beer).
